Due to a historical dispute, no direct path exists between Site Alpha and Site Beta.
Furthermore, a logistical mandate requires that exactly one of two specific ancient pathways must be incorporated into the circuit: either the route between Site Beta and Site Gamma, or the route between Site Gamma and Site Delta.

The objective is to determine the most concise possible circuit that inspects each site precisely once and concludes at the initial point of departure.
